facts.statement: Longchengornis is classified as a genus of enantiornithean birds.
facts.quote: Longchengornis is a genus of enantiornithean birds

facts.statement: The species Longchengornis sanyanensis was named and described in 1997 by Hou Lianhai.
facts.quote: The type species Longchengornis sanyanensis was named and described in 1997 by Hou Lianhai

facts.statement: Longchengornis lived during the Early Cretaceous Period, approximately 120 million years ago.
facts.quote: Longchengornis is a genus of enantiornithean birds which lived during the early Cretaceous Period, about 120 mya

facts.statement: Fossils of Longchengornis have been found in the Jiufotang Formation in Liaoning province, China.
facts.quote: known from a fossil found in the Jiufotang Formation in Liaoning province, People's Republic of China

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Longchengornis measured 11 cm in length, 7.5 cm in hip height, and weighed 20 grams.
facts.quote: Holotype IVPP V10530 indicates an animal with a length of 11 cm, hip height of 7.5 cm, and weight of 20 g

facts.statement: Longchengornis had a wide upper arm bone with a unique circular depression at the shoulder joint.
facts.quote: Longchengornis is characterized by a wide humerus (upper arm bone) expanded at the shoulder joint, where there was a unique circular depression in the deltopectoral crest

facts.statement: The species possessed long, slender legs equipped with large, hooked claws.
facts.quote: The species had long, slender legs with large, hooked claws

facts.statement: The hand of Longchengornis retained at least two claws.
facts.quote: the hand retained at least two claws

facts.statement: Longchengornis belongs to the parent group Cathayornithidae.
Longchengornis is classified within the family Cathayornithidae.
The time range for Longchengornis is estimated from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Some researchers debate whether Longchengornis sanyanensis is a synonym of the similar species Cathayornis yandica.
facts.quote: though some researchers believe this to be a synonym of the similar species Cathayornis yandica

rejected.quote: The generic name Longchengornis combines the older name of Chaoyang, Longcheng or Dragon City
